verdict.rationale: Bruno is offline-only with no cloud sync: collections live as plain-text files in a folder on the user's own filesystem, so the user decides where the data resides and Bruno has no visibility into it. Bruno AI uses bring-your-own-key and can point at self-hosted or local models, and no data is routed through Bruno servers. Community comments corroborate that avoiding external cloud storage is the main draw. Missing for 10: explicit docs on choosing the collection storage location, independent hands-on verification that no data leaves the machine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Bruno is offline-only. There are no plans to add cloud-sync to Bruno, ever.
Bruno stores your collections directly in a folder on your filesystem.
No cloud sync. No account. No login. We have zero visibility into your requests
No data is routed through Bruno servers.
self-hosted inference servers, and local model applications such as Ollama or LM Studio
